blocks.html: Robinsons Malls is redefining weekends at Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Place Manila’s Al Fresco areas as these transform into cool and cozy hangout places you’d definitely want to be at. Dubbed as “Chill Nights at the Al Fresco”, diners going solo or with friends can enjoy free bottles of ice cold beer with their minimum purchase from participating food outlets and restaurants. Plus, Robinsons Galleria patrons get to bring home a beer mug too, for minimum purchase of P3,000. Of course, dim lights, airy ambiance and live acoustic music complete the experience!

Enjoy good food and drinks from Robinsons Galleria Al Fresco partners like Chili's, PeriPeri, Kenny Rogers and Crisostomo; Robinsons Place Manila’s food partners- Gerry's Grill, Yellow Cab, Bonchon, Wendy's and Goldilocks; while Robinsons Magnolia partnered with Fiery Style, Arce Haus, Botejyu, Mesa, Ippudo and Ramen Nagi to give shoppers an awesome weekend night cap. So chill out and visit Robinsons Malls’ Chill Nights at the Al Fresco on the following dates- Robinsons Galleria on June 18-19, 25-26; Robinsons Magnolia on June 18-19, 25-26 and Robinsons Place Manila on June 18-19, 25-26 & July 2-3.
